description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [PHY +30% Boost 3] to the user, grants [Damage Cap +10000 3] and [Fealty Mode] to the user if 4+ FF3 allies are alive

description.name: Sasune Rush
description.text: Six single attacks (0.90 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Sasune Guard
description.text: Three single attacks (0.90 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user, grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all FF3 allies

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Fealty Mode
description.text: Casts Knight's Espada after using a Earth ability, removed after triggering three times, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
